title: Mikkel Damsgaard
extract: Mikkel Krogh Damsgaard is a Danish professional footballer who plays as an attacking or central midfielder for Premier League club Brentford and the Denmark national team.

title: Mathias Kvistgaarden
extract: Mathias Damm Kvistgaarden is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Denmark national team.
